date.description: The claim's date: the day its entry posts on, on or after every receipt's.

late_reason.description: Why a line past the claim deadline is claimed late: required before submitting such a claim (FR-AP-15).
examples: The receipt was found after the trip

lines.description: Its lines: a receipt or a trip each.

notes.description: Notes for the approver: why a line is above its limit, for example.
examples: Client lunch ran over the meals limit.
